prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: vertical 4:5 editorial cover image for a Japanese motorboat-racing post
Primary request: A photorealistic late-afternoon Japanese kyotei race on an urban riverside course, with warm low sunlight and light ripples.
Scene/backdrop: subdued urban riverside course; keep the top 45% dark, visually quiet, uncluttered, and free of signage so a title can be overlaid later.
Subject: one authentic Japanese kyotei racing boat banking into a tight left turn around one orange-and-white cylindrical turn buoy. The boat is a single-seat racing craft about 3 meters long, flat, low, and long relative to the racer, with a white or pale-grey hull. It has an OPEN cockpit: no canopy, no roof, no windshield bubble. The racer crouches or kneels very low inside, leaning forward with both hands on a small steering wheel, wearing a completely plain full-face helmet and plain racing suit; face is not visible. Exactly one outboard motor is mounted on the stern, producing a large white spray plume that curves outward behind the turn.
Composition/framing: portrait 4:5; boat and buoy entirely in the lower half; dynamic turning angle; generous dark negative space across the upper 45%.
Lighting/mood: warm low late-afternoon sunlight, dramatic but realistic, natural water reflections.
Constraints: unmistakably kyotei, not an offshore powerboat and not an F1 tunnel boat; no recognizable real person.
Avoid: absolutely no text, letters, digits, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, signage, number plates, flags, pennants, readable markings, extra boats, canopy, roof, windshield bubble, offshore powerboat styling, F1 tunnel hull styling.

verification.method: visual inspection of the generated image
verification.notes: Visually inspected at full image view. The image shows one low, long, light-colored open-cockpit kyotei racing boat banking around an orange-and-white cylindrical buoy in warm late-afternoon light, with a crouched racer whose face is hidden, one stern outboard motor, and a broad curved white spray plume. The upper area is dark and uncluttered. No text, letters, digits, numbers, logos, watermarks, signage, number plates, flags, or recognizable real person are visible.
